title: Icon Geometries for ggplot2
text: ggicons package lets visualise data icons ggplot2. draws vector icons icons package directly ggplot2 plot. Icons can mapped data drawn like points, placed fixed positions annotations, substituted axis, strip legend labels, repeated grid isotype-style pictogram (styled colour, size, alpha angle aesthetics).

title: Icon Geometries for ggplot2
text: geom_icon() draws icon per row (x, y), place point. Map icon vector icons package (e.g. icons::fontawesome$solid$rocket) icon aesthetic, style usual colour, size, alpha angle aesthetics:
code: df <- data.frame(   x = 1:3, y = c(1, 3, 2),   icon = c(     fontawesome$solid$rocket,     fontawesome$solid$star,     fontawesome$solid$heart   ) ) ggplot(df, aes(x, y, icon = icon)) +   geom_icon(size = 12, colour = "steelblue")

title: Icon Geometries for ggplot2
text: icon aesthetic already mapped icon values, scale_icon_identity() passes unchanged. map discrete data column (e.g. category) icon instead, use scale_icon_manual(). ’s automatic discrete palette icons, values always required. Since icon vectors can’t named, values matched positionally sorted data levels default; pass limits match different order instead:  Icons drawn geom_icon() also appear legend key glyph, via draw_key_icon(), legend shows actual icon shape instead generic point.
code: df <- data.frame(   x = 1:3, y = c(1, 3, 2),   type = c("rocket", "star", "heart") ) ggplot(df, aes(x, y, icon = type, colour = type)) +   geom_icon(size = 12) +   scale_icon_manual(     limits = c("rocket", "star", "heart"),     values = c(       fontawesome$solid$rocket,       fontawesome$solid$star,       fontawesome$solid$heart     )   ) +   scale_colour_manual(     limits = c("rocket", "star", "heart"),     values = c(rocket = "steelblue", star = "goldenrod", heart = "firebrick")   )

text: geom_pictogram() understands following aesthetics (value icon required): x, y: grid's anchor position. Leaving one draws bar/column chart instead fixed-position grid; see stat_pictogram()'s Orientation section. value: magnitude pictogram represents. stat_pictogram() turns filled slot count using symbol_value, amount one icon stands . title: Pictograms — geom_pictogram
code: library(ggplot2)  # bundled placeholder shapes; a real pack (e.g. icons::fontawesome) works the same shapes <- icons::icon_set(system.file("icons", package = "ggicons"))  # 10x10 waffle: 37% ggplot(NULL, aes(x = "Proportion", value = 37)) +   geom_pictogram(icon = shapes$square, n = 100, nrow = 10)   # single-row rating: 5 slots, 3 filled, legend switched off ggplot(NULL, aes(y = "Rating", value = 3)) +   geom_pictogram(icon = shapes$star, n = 5, colour = "goldenrod") +   guides(value = "none")   # growing isotype chart: two categories, each sized to its own value pets <- data.frame(animal = c("Cat", "Dog"), count = c(23, 15)) ggplot(pets, aes(animal, y = "Pet", value = count, icon = animal, colour = animal)) +   geom_pictogram(nrow = 5) +   scale_icon_manual(values = c(icons::fontawesome$solid$cat, icons::fontawesome$solid$dog))  # column chart: no y aesthetic, so icons fill like a column geometry commutes <- data.frame(mode = c("Bicycle", "Car"), count = c(890, 1230)) ggplot(commutes, aes(mode, value = count, icon = mode, colour = mode)) +   geom_pictogram(ncol = 5) +   scale_icon_manual(values = c(icons::fontawesome$solid$bicycle, icons::fontawesome$solid$car)) +   labs(value = "commuters")

title: ggicons: Icon Geometries for 'ggplot2' — ggicons-package
text: Provides icon geometries 'ggplot2', using vector icon sets 'icons' package. geom_icon() draws icon per row place point, styled usual colour, size, alpha angle aesthetics. Icon data passed straight scale_icon_identity(), mapped discrete values scale_icon_manual(). Icons also appear legend keys, fixed-position markers annotation_icon(), axis, strip legend labels via element_icon() theme element. geom_pictogram() draws isotype-style unit charts, waffle/percentage charts rating widgets, encoding value grid repeated icons.

title: Pictogram value guide — guide_pictogram
text: title legend title. Defaults value scale's name (typically set via labs(value = ...), e.g. units value counts). symbol_value Override ratio shown, instead reading matched layer. Rarely needed. label Override key's label text entirely, instead default "= {symbol_value}". icon icon draw key. needed matched layer's icon aesthetic mapped rather fixed (isotype-chart example , category gets icon): single icon show automatically , key falls back plain colour swatch instead guessing category's icon; set pick one deliberately. theme theme object style guide individually differently plot's theme settings. theme argument guide partially overrides, combined , plot's theme. Arguments apply single legend respected, legend-prefix. Arguments apply combined legends (legend box) ignored, including legend.position, legend.justification.*, legend.location legend.box.*. position character string indicating legend placed relative plot panels. One "top", "right", "bottom", "left", "inside". direction character string indicating direction guide. One "horizontal" "vertical". override.aes list specifying aesthetic parameters legend key. See details examples. order positive integer less 99 specifies order guide among multiple guides. controls order multiple guides displayed, contents guide . 0 (default), order determined secret algorithm. ... ignored.

title: ggicons (development version)
text: Initial CRAN submission. Added geom_icon(), geom draws icon per row icon aesthetic, styled colour/fill, size, alpha angle. icon aesthetic takes icon vector icons package directly (e.g. icons::fontawesome$solid$rocket). Added draw_key_icon(), default geom_icon() legend key glyph. Added scale_icon_identity() scale_icon_manual(), plus scale_type.icon() method aes(icon = ...) picks sensible scale. Added annotation_icon(), drawing one icons fixed positions, recycled way annotate() recycles arguments. Added element_icon(), theme() element (parallel element_text()) axis.text/strip.text/legend.text draws label matching name supplied icons lookup icon, falling back ordinary text everything else. Added geom_pictogram() stat_pictogram(), isotype-style unit charts, waffle/percentage charts rating widgets: value turned grid repeated icons, fraction filled . grid can fixed-size (waffle chart) grow value (isotype chart), reads bar/column chart x y left unmapped. Added guide_pictogram() scale_value_continuous(), together give geom_pictogram()’s value aesthetic default legend spelling amount one icon represents (e.g. “= 1000”).
